short: Life Again Therapy provides virtual psychotherapy with compassionate, personalized support. Evening appointments are available.
training: Master of Social Work (MSW); Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW).
pricing: Private pay: therapy $150 for 55 minutes. Limited reduced-fee appointments may be available. Also accepts Cash App.
long: Life Again Therapy offers virtual psychotherapy in a supportive and welcoming environment. Denesia Joseph, MSW, LCSW, helps adults navigate concerns including anxiety, depression, trauma, stress and life transitions. Evening appointments are available. The practice is private pay and does not currently accept or bill insurance. Accepting new clients.
size: Solo practice with the possibility of growing into a group in the future.
